# AbuFarha Medical Supplies

> AbuFarha Medical Supplies is a biomedical engineering company founded in 1999 in Amman, Jordan.
> We supply, install, commission, train and support advanced medical equipment for hospitals
> and healthcare facilities across Africa and the Middle East.

## About

- Legal name: AbuFarha Medical Supplies
- Founded: 1999
- Founder: Dr. Walid AbuFarha
- Headquarters: 4th Floor, Complex 396, Queen Rania Street, Amman, Jordan
- Region served: Africa and the Middle East (10+ countries)
- Healthcare projects delivered: 30+
- Biomedical engineers on staff: 5
- OEM-certified partner network
- Technical support: 24/7
- Website: https://snug-simple-share.lovable.app
- Contact: info@abufarhamedical.com  |  +962 6 4026063

## What we do

AbuFarha is a medical-equipment supplier and biomedical engineering partner —
not a hospital builder or general contractor. Every engagement covers one or
more of:

- Supply of advanced medical equipment from OEM-certified manufacturers
- Site planning, installation and commissioning
- Preventive and corrective maintenance
- Calibration and performance verification
- Clinical and biomedical training
- Long-term technical support and spare-parts logistics
- Turnkey imaging and cardiology department delivery

## Equipment categories

- MRI Scanners
- CT Scanners
- PET/CT Scanners
- Cath Lab Systems
- C-Arm Systems
- X-Ray Systems
- Mammography Systems
- Bone Densitometers (DEXA)
- Lithotripsy (ESWL)
- Drug-Eluting Stents
- Ultrasound and additional modalities

## Editorial policy

All company statistics on this site are drawn from the official AbuFarha
Corporate Profile. Any claim not verified in that profile is not published.
Clinical educational content in the Knowledge Center is reviewed by qualified
medical professionals and cites peer-reviewed sources.
